## Summary

Describe the correction, improvement, or proposed listing.

## Supporting sources

Link to official documentation, release notes, project website, or repository.

## Checklist

- [ ] Factual claims can be verified against primary sources.
- [ ] Links work and do not contain affiliate/tracking parameters.
- [ ] Categories and README counts are updated where necessary.
- [ ] No rating is invented; unrated community listings are labeled.
- [ ] Any relationship to a submitted project is disclosed.

Preferred tool submission form: https://www.reviewramble.com/submit-tool
